field_notes.processed: Dosing weights for acyclovir are controversial. The original package insert recommends dosing on ideal body weight in obesity.  Subsequent studies suggest adjusted body should be used to reduce risk of underdosing.  We recommend initial use of adjusted body weight in obesity with careful monitoring of renal function and mental status with potential for dose reduction as needed.
